title: Chase overdue invoices every day
summary: Every morning, remind each customer who owes you money that is past its due date (invoices and debts written down in chat alike), every few days, in one message per customer, and tell you when one is still unpaid after the last reminder.
description: Once a day at the time you choose, finds what customers owe you that is past its due date and not fully paid: invoices, and debts written down in chat (Ada owes 5,000) once their credit terms have passed. With One message per customer (on unless you turn it off), each customer gets one reminder for everything they owe that is overdue, by SMS, and by email when you have their address, with what they owe in all and a link to one page of all of it, where they pay the whole or a part; off, they get one per invoice, with its number and its link. The first goes the day after the due date, then one every few days, up to the number you choose. After the last reminder you are told once that it is still unpaid. A customer never gets the same reminder twice, even if the workflow runs again the same day. Paid and voided invoices are left alone, and a debt with no due date is never reminded.

params.name: send_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When the reminders go out each day, Lagos time.

params.name: every_days
params.title: Days between reminders
params.description: How many days to leave between two reminders about the same invoice.

params.name: reminders
params.title: Reminders before you are told
params.description: How many reminders a customer gets before you are told the invoice is still unpaid.

params.name: per_customer
params.title: One message per customer
params.description: One reminder per customer for everything they owe that is overdue, instead of one per invoice.

definition.name: Chase overdue invoices
definition.description: Reminds each customer with something overdue every few days, once per customer or once per invoice, then tells the owner.

input.text: A reminder that invoice {number} is overdue: {due} is still due. See it and pay: {link}
input.subject: =item.number + ' is overdue'

steps.name: Note the reminder that could not go
Tell you it is still unpaid after the last reminder

input.title: Invoice still unpaid
input.message: ='Invoice ' + item.number + ' is ' + string(int(item.days_overdue)) + ' days overdue after ' + string({{reminders}}) + ' reminders: ' + item.due + ' still due.'

steps.name: Find the customers with something overdue

input.text: A reminder: {customer_due} is overdue on {customer_lines} item(s). See what you owe and pay: {customer_link}
input.subject: Overdue: {customer_due}

steps.name: Note the reminder that could not go
Tell you a customer still owes after the last reminder

input.title: A customer still owes you
input.message: ='A customer still owes ' + item.due + ' on ' + string(int(item.lines)) + ' item(s), the oldest ' + item.number + ', ' + string(int(item.days_overdue)) + ' days overdue after ' + string({{reminders}}) + ' reminders.'
